extension.perimeterHint: Above the joint the perimeter of the extension is used, below it that of the timber.

factors.sourceHint: The source must match the pile system, installation method and dimensions. Factors from 2025 do not automatically make the complete calculation method compliant with 2025.

pile.title: Pile

profile.title: Soil profile
profile.tooShallow: The soil profile ends at NAP {{bottom}} m, above the pile toe at NAP {{toe}} m. No shaft friction is counted over that section; extend the bottom layer.

facts.extensionValue: {{size}} mm, from pile head to the joint at NAP {{joint}} m
facts.title: Basic assumptions

negSkin.title: Negative skin friction
negSkin.zone: Zone: pile head NAP {{top}} to NAP {{bottom}} —

pending.missingEA: Enter the axial stiffness EA under Pile. For this pile type EA is not derived from the cross-section; the value follows from the selected pile system.
pending.note: As soon as the input is complete, the worked calculation appears here.

summary.conclusionFail: the pile does not comply; N<sub>Ed</sub> = {{nEd}} kN exceeds R<sub>c;net;d</sub> = {{rc}} kN.
summary.conclusionNoLoad: no design load entered; the net bearing capacity is R<sub>c;net;d</sub> = {{rc}} kN.
summary.conclusionPass: the pile complies; N<sub>Ed</sub> = {{nEd}} kN is {{pct}}% of R<sub>c;net;d</sub> = {{rc}} kN.
summary.title: Summary

settings.factorsHint: Empty = table value of the selected code ({{edition}}). A project value requires justification, for example a load test.
settings.seriesHint: The series for the drop-down list in the input (tube sizes) and the Standard series button in the bearing capacity table.

skin.dragHint: Pile levels and skin friction zones can also be dragged in the CPT.
skin.negBottomAria: Bottom of negative skin friction [m NAP]
skin.posTopAria: Top of positive skin friction [m NAP]
skin.title: Skin friction zones

standard.historicalHint: Historical compression calculation for a single pile at a single CPT. Positive shaft friction in sand, constant cross-section or explicit timber taper; settlement and pile groups have not been verified. Changing the code clears project factors and resets γm.
standard.title: Design code

table.cptMissing: CPT {{id}} is missing from the project.
table.heading: Bearing capacity per CPT
table.intro: One pile system in a range of sizes and toe levels, calculated for every CPT. Set the pile type, code and soil profile on the left.
table.title: Bearing capacity table

taper.hintFromHead: The timber diameter decreases linearly from the head; below the tapered part the toe diameter remains constant. The friction perimeter follows the selected length; settlement and spring stiffnesses are not determined.
taper.hintFromJoint: The timber diameter decreases linearly from the joint; below the tapered part the toe diameter remains constant. The friction perimeter follows the selected length; settlement and spring stiffnesses are not determined.
taper.title: Tapered timber pile

target.hint: For each size, the selection table finds the shortest pile that reaches the lower limit. Above the upper limit the size is ample.
target.inverted: The upper limit must be above the lower limit; the table still uses the previous band.
target.notNumber: Enter the lower and upper limit as a number in kN.

empty.howTo: Open a GEF, BRO-XML or project file via Open at the top. Then select the CPT under CPT in the input panel.
empty.noCpt: No CPT has been linked to this calculation yet.
empty.then: The cone resistance, the pile and the skin friction zones will then appear here.
empty.title: CPT chart
